title: Server

unavailable.title: Nothing to manage here
unavailable.noHelper: Helena runs without the host helper (in a container, for example). Disks, backups and fans are then managed outside Helena.
unavailable.failed: The host helper did not answer.

health.raidChecking: Mirror {name} is being checked: {percent}, about {remaining} to go.
health.raidMismatches: Mirror {name}: {count, plural, one {# mismatch} other {# mismatches}} in the last check.
health.raidOk: Mirror {name}: {disks, plural, one {one disk} other {# disks}}, in sync.
health.diskFailing: Disk {disk} reports a failure. Replace it.
health.diskSpareLow: Disk {disk}: spare almost used up ({spare} %). Replace it.
health.diskErrors: Disk {disk}: {count, plural, one {# read error} other {# read errors}} reported.

health.eventsCritical: {count, plural, one {One serious report} other {# serious reports}} from mdadm or smartd, not seen yet.

health.backupLate: The last backup was {at} ago, later than planned.

health.healthFailed: The health could not be read.

disks.checkConfirmBody: Reads both disks completely and compares them (the same as the automatic monthly check). It takes a few hours and slows the disks down a little; Helena keeps running.
disks.mismatches: {count, plural, =0 {No mismatches in the last check.} one {# mismatch in the last check.} other {# mismatches in the last check.}}
disks.selfTestStarted: The self-test is running (a few minutes).

smart.none: This disk gives no SMART data.

boot.title: Boot
boot.espDiffer: The EFI partitions differ ({count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}). They are made equal after every package update.
boot.espUnknown: The state of the EFI partitions is unknown.
boot.canceled: The next boot uses the normal order again.
boot.set: The next restart boots the reserve disk.
boot.pending: The next restart boots once from the reserve disk; normal again after that.
boot.confirmTitle: Boot once from the reserve disk?
boot.confirmBody: At the next restart the machine boots once through the entry "Debian (Reserve)" from the second disk. This proves it also comes up without the first disk. You restart it yourself; afterwards the normal order applies again.

replace.title: Replace a disk of the mirror
replace.intro: Step by step, with the commands for this machine. Helena does not run them: you type them into the owner terminal. The server keeps running on the other disk meanwhile.
replace.noPlan: There is no plan for this disk: it is not part of a mirror, or a healthy second disk is missing.

step.remove: Take it out of the mirror
step.removeBody: Mark disk {disk} (partition {partition}) as failed and remove it. If it is already gone, skip this step.
step.swapBody: Shut the machine down and swap the disk. The new one must be at least {size}. The machine boots from disk {other} (after about 20 seconds, because the mirror is incomplete).
step.newDevice: Device of the new disk (the one without partitions)
step.newDeviceInvalid: Give a whole device, for example /dev/nvme0n1.
step.espBody: Formats the EFI partition, enters it into /etc/fstab as {mount} and copies the contents of {other}.
step.addBody: The mirror then rebuilds; the progress shows on this page (a few hours).
step.bootBody: Creates the firmware entry "{label}" for the new disk and removes the orphaned one. The new number is in the output.
step.testBody: When the mirror shows "in sync": boot the reserve disk once from this page and restart.

events.title: Reports
events.markSeen: {count, plural, one {Mark as seen} other {Mark # as seen}}

codes.FansRestored: Fans back to the chosen level

started.maintenance: Pruning and the check are running.

notSetUp.title: Backups are not set up yet
notSetUp.description: Run this once on the server: it creates the password and the repository on the RAID and schedules the backups.

backup.runningNow: A backup is running right now.
backup.unreadable: {count, plural, one {One file was not readable} other {# files were not readable}} and is missing from the last snapshot.
backup.checkWeekly: Prune weekly and check a sample

explain.off: No scheduled backups; "Back up now" still works.

retention.keepSomething: At least one snapshot has to be kept.

checks.title: Checks
checks.restoreTestDetail: {files} sample files and the database {database} ({tables} tables) could be restored.

paths.title: What is backed up
paths.explain: Plus the databases (pg_dump) and the agents' SQLite files. Caches, node_modules and the agents' test environments are left out.

password.title: Write down the backup password
password.explain: Without this password the backup cannot be read, also not by Helena after a reinstall. Write it on paper or into your password manager. After you confirm, Helena never shows it again.
password.written: I have written the password down safely.
password.confirmed: Confirmed. Helena no longer shows the password.

targets.title: Offsite
targets.explain: Every backup is also copied into S3 storage (Backblaze B2, Hetzner, Cloudflare R2, for example). The key stays with the host helper.
targets.saved: The target is saved; the next backup is copied there.

browse.title: Snapshot {snapshot}
browse.explain: Open folders, then restore a file or a folder.
browse.notFound: This folder is not in this snapshot.

mode.copyHome: Into a new folder ~/Wiederhergestellt/…. Nothing is overwritten.
mode.copyRoot: Into a new folder under /var/backups/helena/restores (root only). Nothing is overwritten.
mode.originalExplain: What is there now is first moved to ….vor-wiederherstellung-….

notInstalled.title: Fan and power control is not installed
notInstalled.description: Board {board}. The control needs the EC driver, ryzen_smu, ryzenadj and power-profiles-daemon; the install script sets them up and puts the fans to level 5 first.

profile.title: Profile
profile.partly: Not every layer took the profile: {layers}.

explain.saver: BIOS quiet ({stapm} W sustained, {fast} W short), OS power saving.
explain.balanced: BIOS balanced ({stapm} W sustained, {fast} W short), OS balanced.
explain.performance: BIOS performance ({stapm} W sustained, {fast} W short), OS performance.

layer.ecLimits: {stapm} W sustained · {fast} W short · {slow} W average

fans.title: Fans
fans.autoExplain: The EC runs the fans on its own curve.
fans.heldByGuard: Saved. The fans stay at level 5 until the CPU has cooled down.
fans.guardActive: The fan guard holds the fans at level 5 (CPU at {temperature}, for {since}).

guard.title: Fan guard
guard.explain: When the fans are fixed below level 5 and the CPU stays at {limit} or more for a few seconds, Helena puts them to level 5. Below {release} for two minutes, your level comes back.
guard.active: Holding the fans at level 5 right now.
